(Japanese: '''{{j|やろうぜ！ポケモンカードゲーム}}''' ''Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game!'') is a one-shot {{pkmn|manga}} by [[Ryū Matsushima]] based on the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. It was published in an extra book of the ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Ichiban!]]'' March 2013 issue titled (Japanese: '''{{j|ポケモンカードゲームＢＷ　プラズマ団大進撃ブック}}''' ''Pokémon Card Game BW: Team Plasma All-Out Assault Book''), released on January 21, 2013. It is followed by [[Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game XY!]]. It is 14 pages long.
